headline: Indian equities rally as Nifty 50 gains 1.1% and Rupee hits seven-month high
summary: India's Nifty 50 benchmark index rose 1.14% to 25,514.30 led by auto and financial stocks, while the Indian rupee appreciated to 93.29 against the U.S. dollar.
why: The Nifty 50 is the primary equity index tracking large-cap companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India.

impacts.name: Nifty 50
impacts.why: Automotive and banking stocks rallied, lifting the benchmark domestic stock index.
